WITH BettingAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        AVG(bd.betting_spread) AS avg_initial_spread,
        COUNT(bd.betting_id) AS total_bets
    FROM games g
    JOIN betting_data bd ON g.game_id = bd.game_id
    GROUP BY g.game_id
),
PredictionAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        gp.game_id,
        AVG(gp.confidence_level) AS avg_confidence,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gp.make_pick = 1 AND g.pick_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_predictions
    FROM games g
    JOIN game_predictions gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id
    GROUP BY gp.game_id
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.team_id,
        AVG(tm.wdvoa) AS avg_wdvoa
    FROM team_metrics tm
    GROUP BY tm.team_id
),
GameLocationSimilarity AS (
    SELECT 
        g.game_id,
        vec.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM games g
    JOIN (
        SELECT game_id, rowid, distance 
        FROM games 
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Stadium: 123 Main St, Boston, MA. Capacity: 50,000. Home team: Patriots")
        ORDER BY distance
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON g.rowid = vec.rowid
)
SELECT 
    g.game_id,
    pa.avg_confidence
FROM games g
JOIN BettingAnalysis ba ON g.game_id = ba.game_id
JOIN PredictionAnalysis pa ON g.game_id = pa.game_id
JOIN TeamPerformance tp ON g.home_team_id = tp.team_id
JOIN GameLocationSimilarity gls ON g.game_id = gls.game_id
WHERE pa.correct_predictions > 2
ORDER BY g.game_id;

    SELECT 
        ti.indicator_id,
        ti.name AS indicator_name,
        COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count,
        AVG(a.threshold) AS avg_threshold
    FROM technical_indicators ti
    JOIN alerts a ON ti.indicator_id = a.indicator_id
    WHERE a.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY ti.indicator_id
),
StockSectorSimilarity AS (
    SELECT 
        s.stock_id,
        s.symbol,
        vec.distance AS sector_similarity
    FROM stocks s
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM stocks 
        WHERE sector_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Technology sector in the USA")
        ORDER BY distance
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON s.rowid = vec.rowid
),
ExchangeLocationSimilarity AS (
    SELECT 
        e.exchange_id,
        vec.distance AS location_similarity
    FROM exchanges e
    JOIN (
        SELECT rowid, distance 
        FROM exchanges 
        WHERE location_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "New York Stock Exchange, 11 Wall St, New York, NY 10005, USA")
        ORDER BY distance
        LIMIT 5
    ) AS vec ON e.rowid = vec.rowid
),
AccessLogAnalysis AS (
    SELECT 
        al.user_id,
        COUNT(al.log_id) AS access_count,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT al.action) AS actions
    FROM access_logs al
    WHERE al.action IN ('view', 'download')
    GROUP BY al.user_id
)

)
JOIN AccessLogAnalysis ala ON ala.user_id IN (
    SELECT user_id FROM alerts WHERE stock_id = md.stock_id
)
WHERE ia.alert_count > 2
ORDER BY md.data_id;
